support.quote:
import nanosurf

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# All variables
scan = application.Scan
zcontrol = application.ZController

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm
scan.Scantime = 0.1  # Time per line in seconds
scan.Lines = 32  # Lines per frame

# Set Z controller parameters
zcontrol.PGain = 100
zcontrol.IGain = 6000
zcontrol.DGain = 10

# Start scan
application.StartScan()
